raw.query: WITH evidence AS (SELECT d.run_id, d.experiment, d.window_name, d.window_requests, d.quantile, d.is_current, d.superseded_by, i.achieved_p99_ms, i.n_requests FROM provenance.v_dim AS d JOIN provenance.v_infraction AS i ON i.run_id = d.run_id AND i.pool = d.pool AND i.is_current = TRUE WHERE d.is_current = TRUE AND d.run_id IN ('live:twin_fc_p90', 'planner:week_fc_p90') AND d.policy = 'forecast' AND d.quantile = 'p90' AND i.sla_metric = 'ttft' AND i.bound_stat = 'p99'), paired AS (SELECT MAX(achieved_p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE experiment = 'live') AS live_ms, MAX(achieved_p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE experiment = 'planner') AS offline_ms FROM evidence) SELECT e.run_id, e.experiment, e.window_name, e.window_requests, e.n_requests, e.is_current, e.superseded_by, e.achieved_p99_ms, ROUND(e.achieved_p99_ms) AS displayed_ms, CASE WHEN e.experiment = 'live' THEN 100.0 * (p.live_ms - p.offline_ms) / p.offline_ms END AS live_delta_pct, CASE WHEN e.experiment = 'live' THEN ROUND((100.0 * (p.live_ms - p.offline_ms) / p.offline_ms)::numeric, 1) END AS displayed_delta_pct FROM evidence AS e CROSS JOIN paired AS p ORDER BY e.experiment
